hypothesis: The known 255 multiplicative offsets times eight Frobenius offsets might lower the XOR/XNOR cost of fixed 29-AND and 28-AND circuits after fusing the outer maps into their affine boundaries.

construction.scope: Replace affine prefix before the first AND and suffix after the last AND in the pinned SLP order. Retain the middle (101, 107 or 97 gates depending on source). Charge for transformed inputs consumed downstream; track affine phases and outputs computed before the final AND.

sweeps.heuristic: exact-word-distance greedy, phases absorbed into XOR/XNOR

failed_attempts_retained.failure: Early output S2 missing from suffix boundary
Complement absorption crossed the fixed-middle boundary

prefix_lower_bounds.rule: Each distinct required non-source linear form costs a gate. If the target-only XOR closure fails, at least one additional auxiliary form is necessary. Ignoring constants weakens this bound; it is not a whole-circuit optimum.
prefix_lower_bounds.boundary: Bounds apply to raw eight input sources and the fixed affine-prefix/retained-middle model only.

current_prior_art.normalization: U0..U7 and S0..S7, MSB first; no logic changes.
current_prior_art.claim_boundary: Reproduction of public prior art, not a locally discovered circuit; no mapping, physical or security measurement.
current_prior_art.inventory_scope: All forward AES S-box files in aes-sbox/, sbox/ and old-2020/ of this pinned official tree, not all global research.
current_prior_art.attribution: Official README credits 28-AND contributions to Milad Nasr (@ Anthropic), communicated 2026-09-24; local work does not claim authorship or independent replay of the contributor's Lean proof.
current_prior_art.effect: The public 28-AND/124-gate/GD27/AD5 circuit dominates the local 29-AND/136-gate/GD33/AD6 candidate. Neither the previous 137 nor 136 threshold establishes novelty. The repository also contains 110-gate circuits with 32 or 34 ANDs; 124 is not an unrestricted minimum-gate record.

conclusion: Five completed boundary sweeps produce no improvement over their respective sources. The separate 136-gate local resubstitution is correct but dominated by the newer public 28-AND/124-gate source. Exhausting 2040 parameters under these heuristics is not exhaustive circuit synthesis. No world-first, globally optimal circuit, mapped improvement or physical/security result is established.

research_sources.fact: The official pinned repository lists 28-AND constructions including 124 gates and attributes contributions to Milad Nasr. It also lists 110-gate constructions using more ANDs.
The current NIST table lists the 29-AND, 108-affine, depth32, AND-depth5 source; exact downloaded source was independently evaluated.
The primary paper describes multiplicative and exponential offset fusion and the 2040 hardware mapping choices. The transformation technique is established prior art.
Primary self-equivalence reference independently documents the 2040-element structure.
Boyar-Peralta linear-circuit optimization is established prior art; the local greedy backend is not claimed as a new method.
